# awscc_apiportal_product (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::APIPortal::Product



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `api_selection_configuration` (Attributes) Configuration controlling how APIs are selected for the product. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_selection_configuration))
- `description` (String) A description of the product.
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the product.
- `product_arn` (String) The ARN of the product.
- `product_id` (String) The product identifier.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags associated with the product. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the product was last modified.
